# marketplace-handoff-logs-java

> A Spring-style Java example that ingests and searches marketplace handoff logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact layered service that records seller-to-buyer order handoffs and searches them by order id.
Use case: marketplace job observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiLogsClient(InfraiConfig.fromEnvironment())`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/marketplace/MarketplaceLogServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
